# Learning Objectives

You will convert static `ggplot2` graphics into accessible interactive Plotly products.

# Setup

Load:

- `tidyverse`
- `gapminder`
- `plotly`
- `DT`

```{r, load-packages}

library(tidyverse)
library(gapminder)
# install.packages("plotly")
library(plotly)
# install.packages("DT")
library(DT)

```

# Part 1: Prepare Data

Create a 2007 Gapminder dataset and rename the major variables.

```{r, prepare-data}

data <- gapminder %>%
  filter(year == 2007)

data <- data %>%
   rename(
    life_expectancy = lifeExp,
    population = pop,
    gdp_per_capita = gdpPercap
  )

```

# Part 2: Static Baseline

Create a clear static scatterplot of GDP per capita and life expectancy.

```{r, static-plot}

static_plot <- ggplot(
  data,
  aes(
    x = gdp_per_capita,
    y = life_expectancy,
    color = continent
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(group = 1),
      method = "lm",
      se = FALSE,
      color = "gray30",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(
     values = c(
      "Africa" = "#F8766D",
      "Americas" = "#7CAE00",
      "Asia" = "#00BFC4",
      "Europe" = "#C77CFF",
      "Oceania" = "#FF61C3"
     ) 
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "GDP per capita and Life Expectancy in 2007",
    subtitle = "Relationship between GDP per capita and life expectancy by continent",
    x = "GDP per capita (log scale)",
    y = "Life Expectency",
    caption = "Data Source: Gapminder"
    )

static_plot

```

## Save

```{r, save-static-plot}

ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/lab07_staticplot.png",
  plot = static_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

```
